definitions.full: H639. aph I. אַף 277 noun masculine Gen 30:2 nostril, nose, face, anger (Assyrian appu , face Flood iii. 27, 29 compare Hpt KAT 2Gloss , Arabic , Ethiopic nose ; Aramaic , אֲנְמִּין face ) — absolute Psa 78:21 +; construct Gen 27:45 +; suffix אַמּי Exod 22:23 +, etc.; du אַמַּיִם Prov 14:17 +; אַמָּיו Gen 2:7 + etc.; — In Hexateuch J E ( Josh 7:1 P? 23:16 D?). 1 nostril , as organ of breathing Gen 2:7 ; 7:22 ; Job 27:3 compare Num 11:20 ; 2Sam 22:9 = Psa 18:9 compare Isa 65:5 ; 2:22 ; Lam 4:20 ; Ezek 38:18 (strike out Co) Amos 4:10 ; אַמֶּיךָ רוּחַ (of ׳י ) i.e. wind Exod 15:8 ; compare אַמּוֺ רוּחַ נִשְׁמַת 2Sam 22:16 = Psa 18:16 (see also below 3 ); nose singular Cant 7:5, 9; Ezek 8:17 ; 23:25 ; Prov 30:33 (where play upon different meaning of אַף & אַמַּיִם ): ( a ) as organ of smelling Deut 33:10 ; Psa 115:6 ; ( b ) as place of ring for ornament Gen 24:47 ; Isa 3:21 ; Ezek 16:12 ; ( c ) as place of ring or hook for captive 2Kin 19:28 = Isa 37:29 ; for beasts, e.g. swine Prov 11:22 ; hippopotamus Job 40:24 ; crocodile Job 40:26. 2 Du face (especially in phrase אַרְצָה אַמַּיִם ) Gen 19:1 ; 42:6 ; 48:12 ; Num 22:31 ; 1Sam 20:41 ; 24:9 ; 25:41 ; 28:14 ; 2Sam 14:4 , 33 ; 18:28 ; 24:20 ; 1Kin 1:23 , 31 ; Isa 49:23 ; 1Chr 21:21 ; 2Chr 7:3 ; 20:18 ; Neh 8:6 also Gen 3:19 ; אַמּוֺ גֹּבַהּ pride of his countenance Psa 10:4 ; לְאַמֵּי before , local sense (compare לִפְנֵי ) 1Sam 25:23 ; אַמָּ֑יִם 1:5 read ᵐ5 אֶפֶס We Dr (q. v.) 3 mostly anger , human Gen 27:45 ; 49:6-7 , + (45 t.); oftener divine Exod 32:12 ; Deut 9:19 ; 2Kin 24:20 + (177 t.); often subject חָרָה ( וַיִּ֫חַר etc.) his anger was kindled Gen 30:2 ; 39:19 ; Exod 4:14 ; 22:23 ; 32:10-11 , +; in various combinations, especially אַף חֲרוֺן fierceness of anger 32:12 ; Num 25:4 ; 32:14 +; compare חֳרִיאָֿף 1Sam 20:34 ; בַּעַלאַֿף Prov 22:24 one given to anger , etc.; אַמַּיִם אֶרֶךְ slow to anger Exod 34:6 ; Num 14:18 ; Neh 9:17 7 t. of God; Prov 14:29 ; 15:18 ; 16:32 ; 25:15 of man.
